citations.narrative:
The rough legged hawk enclosure contains an A-frame perch which is covered with an "Astroturf" type carpet material.
Some of the material was identified having shredded and frayed ends, which could potentially lead to injury if the birds'
legs were to become entangled.
Furniture-type objects, such as perches and other objects that enrich a bird’s environment, must be species-appropriate
and be designed, constructed, and maintained so as to prevent harm to the bird. All facilities must ensure that enclosures
are kept in good repair in order to minimize risk of injury to the birds.
*******Corrected on June 24, 2026 at the time of inspection
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representatives.
